newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Tuesday for the third successive session in dull trade and speculation about a relief package the interim government has promised for the textile industry, dealers said.
They said spinners were buying very selectively in anticipation of the package.
The government is expected to lower duties on import of raw cotton and synthetic fibres to help the textile industry cope with a shortfall in domestic cotton output.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,200 rupees ($54.69) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
